info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Delete Healthcare Appointments Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the cancellation of scheduled healthcare appointments, streamlining the process for users and providers alike. By utilizing this interface, healthcare professionals and patients can efficiently manage appointment statuses, ensuring that resources are appropriately allocated. This functionality is particularly useful for practices aiming to reduce no-shows and improve scheduling accuracy. Typical consumers of this API include healthcare clinics, hospitals, and appointment management systems seeking to enhance operational workflows.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel a previously scheduled appointment. It will remove the appointment from the calendar and free up the time slot for other users.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a specific appointment. Please ensure to provide the necessary details required for successfully processing the cancellation.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelReques.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling an appointment operation.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.title: Cancel Appointment Response

status.description: Indicates if the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: ID of the result associated with the cancellation.

state.description: The current state of the appointment after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation response.

audit.description: Details about the audit of the cancellation request.
